### fig 4
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

call_cols <- c(
  "call_Illumina",
  "call_ppmSeq_multiread",
  "call_ppmSeq_singleton_HC",
  "call_UDSeq_multiread",
  "call_UDSeq_singleton",
  "call_NanoSeq_multiread",
  "call_NanoSeq_singleton",
  "call_HiDEFseq_double_stranded",
  "call_HiDEFseq_single_stranded",
  "call_PTA_singleton"
)

exist_cols <- c(
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_ILLUMINA",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_PPMSEQ",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_UDSEQ",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_NANOSEQ",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_HIDEFSEQ",
  "existing_any_PTA1_16"
)


exist_cols_full <- c(
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_ILLUMINA",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_PPMSEQ",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_UDSEQ",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_NANOSEQ",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_HIDEFSEQ",
  "existing_any_PTA1_16"
)


get_self_exist_cols <- function(callset) {
  if (callset == "call_Illumina")
    return("is_existing_lower_ci_0001_ILLUMINA")

  if (callset %in% c("call_ppmSeq_multiread", "call_ppmSeq_singleton_HC"))
    return("is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_PPMSEQ")

  if (callset %in% c("call_UDSeq_multiread", "call_UDSeq_singleton"))
    return("is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_UDSEQ")

  if (callset %in% c("call_NanoSeq_multiread", "call_NanoSeq_singleton"))
    return("is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_NANOSEQ")

  if (callset %in% c("call_HiDEFseq_double_stranded", "call_HiDEFseq_single_stranded"))
    return("is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_HIDEFSEQ")

  if (callset == "call_PTA_singleton")
    return("existing_any_PTA1_16")

  character(0)
}

call_levels <- stringr::str_replace(call_cols, "^call_", "")

call_to_exist_prop <- lapply(call_cols, function(cc) {
  df_call <- filt %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[cc]] == 1)

  if (nrow(df_call) == 0)
    return(NULL)

  self_cols <- get_self_exist_cols(cc)
  other_exist_cols <- setdiff(exist_cols, self_cols)

  other_n <- rowSums(
    df_call[, other_exist_cols, drop = FALSE] == 1,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  tibble(
    callset = stringr::str_replace(cc, "^call_", ""),
    overlap_class = dplyr::case_when(
      other_n == 0 ~ "private",
      other_n == 1 ~ "overlap_1",
      other_n >= 2 ~ "overlap_ge_2"
    )
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::count(callset, overlap_class, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(callset) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    callset = factor(callset, levels = rev(call_levels)),
    overlap_class = factor(
      overlap_class,
      levels = c("overlap_ge_2", "overlap_1", "private")
    )
  )

lab_df <- call_to_exist_prop %>%
  dplyr::mutate(overlap_class = as.character(overlap_class)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(callset) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(overlap_class, c("private", "overlap_1", "overlap_ge_2")),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_center = cumsum(prop) - prop / 2,
    y_edge = cumsum(prop),
    y_line = y_edge + 0.020,
    y_label = y_edge + 0.035,
    label = ifelse(
      prop >= 0.042,
      scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1),
      scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.01)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

```

### Fig 4d
```{r fig4d, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=6.7, dpi=450}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)


exist_cols <- exist_cols_full



support_cols <- c(
  setdiff(exist_cols,
          c("existing_any_PTA1_16")
))

# ---- settings ----
# map evidence col -> MAF col (adjust here if your column names differ)
# 1) evidence col -> raw platform token (remove prefix only)
platform_raw <- stringr::str_remove(support_cols, "^is_existing_lower_ci_0001_")

# is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_PPMSEQ -> DUPLEX_PPMSEQ_VAF
evidence_to_maf <- stats::setNames(
  paste0(platform_raw, "_MAF"),
  support_cols
)

# 3) pretty platform label for facets (remove prefix + optional DUPLEX_)
pretty_plat <- function(x) {
  stringr::str_remove(x, "^is_existing_lower_ci_0001_") %>%
    stringr::str_remove("^DUPLEX_")
}

plats <- pretty_plat(support_cols)

# ---- build long MAF table (only variants with evidence in that platform) ----
maf_long <- bind_rows(lapply(support_cols, function(ec) {
  maf_col <- evidence_to_maf[[ec]]
  stopifnot(!is.null(maf_col))
  if (!maf_col %in% colnames(filt)) stop(paste("Missing VAF column:", maf_col))

  filt %>%
    transmute(
      platform = pretty_plat(ec),
      maf = .data[[maf_col]],
      has_evidence = .data[[ec]] == 1
    ) %>%
    filter(has_evidence, !is.na(maf))
}), .id = NULL) %>%
  select(-has_evidence)

# ---- make vid once ----
if (all(c("chr","pos","ref","alt") %in% colnames(filt))) {
  filt <- filt %>% mutate(vid = paste(chr, pos, ref, alt, sep=":"))
} else {
  filt <- filt %>% mutate(vid = row_number())
}

# ---- build long MAF table (only variants with evidence) ----
maf_long <- bind_rows(lapply(support_cols, function(ec) {
  maf_col <- evidence_to_maf[[ec]]
  if (!maf_col %in% colnames(filt)) stop(paste("Missing VAF column:", maf_col))

  filt %>%
    transmute(
      vid = vid,
      platform = pretty_plat(ec),
      maf = .data[[maf_col]],
      has_evidence = .data[[ec]] == 1
    ) %>%
    filter(has_evidence, !is.na(maf))
})) %>%
  dplyr::select(-has_evidence)

# ---- wide for pairwise (shared variants only; both platforms have evidence) ----
maf_wide <- maf_long %>%
  mutate(platform = factor(platform, levels = plats)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = platform, values_from = maf)

# ---- build all ordered pairs (x,y), drop self ----
pairs <- expand.grid(
  x = plats,
  y = plats,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(x != y) %>%
  as_tibble()

# ---- collect pairwise points + stats ----
pair_df <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) {
  x <- pairs$x[i]
  y <- pairs$y[i]

  d <- maf_wide %>%
    select(vid, all_of(c(x, y))) %>%
    rename(x_maf = !!x, y_maf = !!y) %>%
    filter(!is.na(x_maf), !is.na(y_maf))

  n <- nrow(d)
  if (n >= 3) {
    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(d$x_maf, d$y_maf, method = "pearson"))
    r <- unname(ct$estimate)
    p <- ct$p.value
  } else {
    r <- NA_real_
    p <- NA_real_
  }

  d %>%
    mutate(
      x_plat = x,
      y_plat = y,
      n = n,
      r = r,
      p = p
    )
}))

# Adjust once across unique unordered method pairs, then share the same FDR
# values between the scatterplot, correlation heatmap, and bubble plots.
# Pearson r and raw p are calculated on original VAF, not sqrt(VAF).
corr_levels <- plats
corr_ordered <- pair_df %>%
  dplyr::distinct(x_plat, y_plat, n, r, p) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    x_index = match(x_plat, corr_levels),
    y_index = match(y_plat, corr_levels)
  )

corr_unique <- corr_ordered %>%
  dplyr::filter(x_index < y_index)

stopifnot(nrow(corr_ordered) == 20L, nrow(corr_unique) == 10L)

corr_unique <- corr_unique %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    q = stats::p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
    stars = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(q) & q < 0.001 ~ "***",
      !is.na(q) & q < 0.01 ~ "**",
      !is.na(q) & q < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

corr_pair_stats <- corr_ordered %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pair_x_index = pmin(x_index, y_index),
    pair_y_index = pmax(x_index, y_index)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    corr_unique %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        pair_x_index = x_index,
        pair_y_index = y_index,
        q,
        stars
      ),
    by = c("pair_x_index", "pair_y_index")
  )

# Text labels per facet (one row each); mirrored facets share one FDR.
lab_df <- corr_pair_stats %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "n=", n,
      "\nr=", ifelse(is.na(r), "NA", sprintf("%.3f", r)),
      "\nFDR=", ifelse(is.na(q), "NA", format(q, digits = 2, scientific = TRUE))
    ),
    x_pos = sqrt(0.29),
    y_pos = sqrt(0.29)
  )

pair_df <- pair_df %>%
  mutate(
    x_plat = factor(x_plat, levels = plats),
    y_plat = factor(y_plat, levels = plats)
  )

lab_df <- lab_df %>%
  mutate(
    x_plat = factor(x_plat, levels = plats),
    y_plat = factor(y_plat, levels = plats)
  )


# Match Fig. 5g: sqrt coordinates, but tick labels retain original VAF units.
vaf_axis_breaks <- c(0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3)
p_fig4d_pairwise <- ggplot(pair_df, aes(x = sqrt(x_maf), y = sqrt(y_maf))) +
  geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_label(
    data = lab_df,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
    size = 7 / ggplot2::.pt,
    family = "Arial",
    fill = "white",
    linewidth = 0,
    label.padding = grid::unit(0.05, "lines"),
    label.r = grid::unit(0, "lines")
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    y_plat ~ x_plat,
    drop = FALSE,
    labeller = ggplot2::labeller(
      x_plat = normalize_seq_method,
      y_plat = normalize_seq_method
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, sqrt(0.3)),
    breaks = sqrt(vaf_axis_breaks),
    labels = as.character(vaf_axis_breaks)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, sqrt(0.3)),
    breaks = sqrt(vaf_axis_breaks),
    labels = as.character(vaf_axis_breaks)
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "sqrt(VAF) (x platform)",
    y = "sqrt(VAF) (y platform)",
    caption = paste0(
      "Pearson r and tests use original VAF; FDR is BH-adjusted across 10 unique method pairs.\n",
      "Axes use sqrt(VAF); tick labels show original VAF. FDR = 0 denotes numerical underflow."
    )
  ) +
  theme_nbt(base_size = 7)

p_fig4d_pairwise
```

### Fig 4e
```{r fig4e, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=5.6, dpi=450}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Reuse the FDR values already calculated across 10 unique pairs in Fig. 4d.
corr_plot <- corr_pair_stats %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    x_plat = factor(x_plat, levels = corr_levels),
    y_plat = factor(y_plat, levels = rev(corr_levels)),
    star_label = stars,
    text_colour = ifelse(!is.na(r) & r >= 0.72, "white", "black")
  )

corr_axis_labels <- function(x) {
  labels <- normalize_seq_method(x)
  labels[labels == "Illumina"] <- "IlluminaSeq"
  labels
}

ggplot(corr_plot, aes(x = x_plat, y = y_plat, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(
    data = corr_plot %>% dplyr::filter(star_label != ""),
    aes(label = star_label, colour = text_colour),
    size = 5.5 / ggplot2::.pt,
    family = "Arial",
    fontface = "bold",
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = corr_axis_labels) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = corr_axis_labels) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#FFFFFF", "#D9EAF7", "#6BAED6", "#2171B5", "#08306B"),
    values = c(0, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    fill = "Pearson r",
    caption = paste0(
      "Pearson r across variants shared by each method pair; two-sided tests with Benjamini-Hochberg\n",
      "adjustment across 10 unique method pairs. *q < 0.05; **q < 0.01; ***q < 0.001."
    )
  ) +
  theme_nbt(base_size = 7)
```

### Fig 4d Pearson correlation bubble matrix
```{r fig4d_bubble, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=5.6, dpi=450}
# q = 0 can occur through numerical underflow for extremely small P values.
# Floor it only for the visual size transformation so every bubble is finite.
fdr_floor <- 1e-300

corr_bubble_df <- corr_plot %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    neg_log10_fdr = -log10(pmax(q, fdr_floor)),
    is_significant = !is.na(q) & q < 0.05
  )

correlation_colours <- c(
  "#FFFFFF", "#D9EAF7", "#6BAED6", "#2171B5", "#08306B"
)

make_corr_bubble_plot <- function(data, method_order, caption_text) {
  plot_data <- data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      x_plat = factor(as.character(x_plat), levels = method_order),
      y_plat = factor(as.character(y_plat), levels = rev(method_order))
    )

  tile_data <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    x_plat = factor(method_order, levels = method_order),
    y_plat = factor(method_order, levels = rev(method_order))
  )

  ggplot() +
    geom_tile(
      data = tile_data,
      aes(x = x_plat, y = y_plat),
      fill = "white",
      color = "grey85",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = plot_data %>% dplyr::filter(!is_significant),
      aes(x = x_plat, y = y_plat, size = neg_log10_fdr, fill = r),
      shape = 21,
      color = "grey65",
      stroke = 0.25,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = plot_data %>% dplyr::filter(is_significant),
      aes(x = x_plat, y = y_plat, size = neg_log10_fdr, fill = r),
      shape = 21,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 1,
      show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      name = "Pearson's r",
      colours = correlation_colours,
      values = c(0, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1),
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = expression(-log[10](FDR)),
      range = c(3, 11),
      limits = c(0, 300),
      breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 300)
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = corr_axis_labels, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = corr_axis_labels, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_fixed() +
    guides(
      fill = guide_colorbar(
        order = 1,
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0,
        barheight = grid::unit(25, "mm"),
        barwidth = grid::unit(3, "mm")
      ),
      size = guide_legend(
        order = 2,
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0,
        override.aes = list(
          shape = 21,
          fill = "grey80",
          color = "black",
          stroke = 0.5
        )
      )
    ) +
    labs(caption = caption_text) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.title = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 7),
      legend.text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 7)
    ) +
    theme_nbt(base_size = 7)
}

bubble_caption <- paste0(
  "Bubble size represents -log10(Benjamini-Hochberg FDR); bold outlines indicate FDR < 0.05.\n",
  "FDR values reported as 0 through numerical underflow are plotted as 1e-300."
)

p_fig4d_bubble <- make_corr_bubble_plot(
  corr_bubble_df,
  method_order = corr_levels,
  caption_text = bubble_caption
)

p_fig4d_bubble
```

### Fig 4d Pearson correlation bubble matrix with dendrogram
```{r fig4d_bubble_dendrogram, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=6.5, dpi=450}
# Build a symmetric Pearson correlation matrix, then cluster with distance = 1-r.
corr_matrix <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = length(corr_levels),
  ncol = length(corr_levels),
  dimnames = list(corr_levels, corr_levels)
)
diag(corr_matrix) <- 1

for (i in seq_len(nrow(corr_unique))) {
  x_method <- corr_unique$x_plat[i]
  y_method <- corr_unique$y_plat[i]
  corr_matrix[x_method, y_method] <- corr_unique$r[i]
  corr_matrix[y_method, x_method] <- corr_unique$r[i]
}

pearson_distance_matrix <- 1 - corr_matrix
pearson_distance_matrix[pearson_distance_matrix < 0] <- 0
pearson_distance <- stats::as.dist(pearson_distance_matrix)
corr_hclust <- stats::hclust(pearson_distance, method = "average")
clustered_method_order <- corr_hclust$labels[corr_hclust$order]

dendrogram_data <- ggdendro::dendro_data(
  stats::as.dendrogram(corr_hclust),
  type = "rectangle"
)

p_corr_dendrogram <- ggplot(
  ggdendro::segment(dendrogram_data)
) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.45,
    lineend = "square"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, length(clustered_method_order) + 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 0, 5.5))

clustered_caption <- paste0(
  bubble_caption,
  " Hierarchical clustering uses average linkage on Pearson distance (1-r)."
)

p_corr_bubble_clustered <- make_corr_bubble_plot(
  corr_bubble_df,
  method_order = clustered_method_order,
  caption_text = clustered_caption
) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5))

p_fig4d_bubble_dendrogram <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  p_corr_dendrogram,
  p_corr_bubble_clustered,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(0.24, 1)
)

p_fig4d_bubble_dendrogram
```

### fig 4f-2
```{r fig4f, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=5.2, dpi=450}
## ---- BAM Evidence: bubble (SigA-E vs COSMIC) ----
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)


# ---- rename map: SBS96A->SigA ... SBS96E->SigE ----
denovo_map_bam <- c(
  "Signature 96-SBS96A" = "SigA",
  "Signature 96-SBS96B" = "SigB",
  "Signature 96-SBS96C" = "SigC",
  "Signature 96-SBS96D" = "SigD",
  "Signature 96-SBS96E" = "SigE",
  "SBS96A" = "SigA",
  "SBS96B" = "SigB",
  "SBS96C" = "SigC",
  "SBS96D" = "SigD",
  "SBS96E" = "SigE"
)

# ---- COSMIC colors (reuse overlaps; add new) ----
cosmic_cols_bam <- c(
  SBS1  = "#A8DADC",
  SBS2  = "#F4A261",
  SBS3  = "#BFD3E6",
  SBS4  = "#C7E9C0",
  SBS5  = "#8EC9B8",
  SBS12 = "#FDD0A2",
  SBS16 = "#B8A1D9",
  SBS31 = "#F6BD60",
  SBS32 = "#9DB4E0",
  SBS51 = "#D9D9D9"

  # new in BAM

)

# ---- parse refit table into long df ----
df_cosmic_refit_mutSig_bamEvidence <- cosmic_refit_mutSig_bamEvidence %>%
  transmute(
    denovo_raw = `De novo extracted`,
    mix_raw = `Global NMF Signatures`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    denovo = recode(denovo_raw, !!!denovo_map_bam, .default = denovo_raw),
    mix_raw = str_replace_all(mix_raw, "\\s*&\\s*", "&"),
    parts = str_split(mix_raw, "&", simplify = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest_longer(parts) %>%
  mutate(
    parts = str_trim(parts),
    cosmic = str_extract(parts, "SBS\\d+"),
    pct = as.numeric(str_match(parts, "\\(([-0-9.]+)%\\)")[,2])
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cosmic), !is.na(pct)) %>%
  select(denovo, cosmic, pct)

y_levels_bam <- c("SigA","SigB","SigC","SigD","SigE")
x_levels_bam <- names(cosmic_cols_bam)

p1_bam <- ggplot(
  df_cosmic_refit_mutSig_bamEvidence %>%
    mutate(
      cosmic = factor(cosmic, levels = x_levels_bam),
      denovo = factor(denovo, levels = y_levels_bam)
    )
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = cosmic, y = denovo, size = pct, fill = cosmic),
    shape = 21,
    color = "grey20",
    stroke = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = cosmic, y = denovo, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct)),
    size = 7 / ggplot2::.pt,
    family = "Arial",
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cosmic_cols_bam, name = "COSMIC") +
  scale_size(
    range = c(9, 18),
    breaks = c(10, 25, 50, 75),
    name = "Contribution (%)"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(factor(y_levels_bam)))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  theme_nbt(base_size = 7)

p1_bam

```


### Fig 4g
```{r fig4g, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=5.9, dpi=450}

## ---- BAM Evidence: sample-sample cosine similarity heatmap (96D) ----
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)


# ---- matrix: rows = 96 contexts, cols = samples ----
mat_96_bam <- bamEvidence_trinuc %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  column_to_rownames("MutationType") %>%
  as.matrix()

# ---- cosine similarity between samples (columns) ----
cos_sim_cols <- function(m){
  m_scaled <- apply(m, 2, function(x){
    s2 <- sum(x^2)
    if (s2 == 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
    x / sqrt(s2)
  })
  t(m_scaled) %*% m_scaled
}

sim_96_bam <- cos_sim_cols(mat_96_bam)

# ---- cosine distance + clustering ----
dist_96_bam <- 1 - sim_96_bam
dist_96_bam[dist_96_bam < 0] <- 0
diag(dist_96_bam) <- 0
hc_96_bam <- hclust(as.dist(dist_96_bam), method = "average")

# ---- color (0-1) ----
col_fun_blue <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1),
  c("#FFFFFF", "#E3EEF9", "#9ECAE1", "#2171B5", "#08306B")
)

ht_bam <- Heatmap(
  sim_96_bam,
  name = "Cosine\nSimilarity",
  col = col_fun_blue,
  cluster_rows = as.dendrogram(hc_96_bam),
  cluster_columns = as.dendrogram(hc_96_bam),
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  column_dend_height = unit(30, "mm"),
  row_names_side = "left",
  row_labels = normalize_seq_method(rownames(sim_96_bam)),
  column_labels = normalize_seq_method(colnames(sim_96_bam)),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = c(0, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1),
    labels = c("0", "0.5", "0.75", "0.9", "1"),
    title = "Cosine similarity",
    title_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7)
  )
)

draw(ht_bam)
```

### fig 4h

```{r fig4h, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=5.0, dpi=450}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)


# ---- matrix: rows = sig, cols = sample ----
mat_raw_bam <- mutSig_bamEvidence %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  column_to_rownames("Samples") %>%
  t()

rownames(mat_raw_bam) <- dplyr::recode(rownames(mat_raw_bam), !!!denovo_map_bam, .default = rownames(mat_raw_bam))

# ---- relative activity (% within each sample) ----
mat_sig_pct_bam <- apply(mat_raw_bam, 2, function(x){
  s <- sum(x)
  if (s == 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  100 * x / s
})
mat_sig_pct_bam <- as.matrix(mat_sig_pct_bam)
rownames(mat_sig_pct_bam) <- rownames(mat_raw_bam)  # SigA-E
colnames(mat_sig_pct_bam) <- colnames(mat_raw_bam)  # Samples

# ---- red-ish but not too aggressive ----
col_fun_red <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
  c("#FFFFFF", "#FDE0DD", "#FCAE91", "#FB6A4A", "#CB181D")
)

ht_sig_bam <- Heatmap(
  mat_sig_pct_bam,
  name = "Activity\n(%)",
  col = col_fun_red,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = as.dendrogram(hc_96_bam),
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  column_dend_height = unit(30, "mm"),
  row_names_side = "left",
  column_labels = normalize_seq_method(colnames(mat_sig_pct_bam)),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7),
  column_names_rot = 90,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    title = "Activity (%)",
    title_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7)
  ),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill){
    grid.text(
      sprintf("%.1f", mat_sig_pct_bam[i, j]),
      x,
      y,
      gp = gpar(
        fontfamily = "Arial",
        fontsize = 7,
        col = ifelse(mat_sig_pct_bam[i, j] >= 80, "white", "black")
      )
    )
  }
)

draw(ht_sig_bam)

```
